name: StackRestaurantCard
description: Browse-list restaurant card with food photography, timing badge, rating, cuisine, and delivery fee.
accessibility: Image alt text uses the restaurant name.
When clickable, wrap with navigation semantics or provide keyboard interaction in the consuming app.

do: Use real food imagery with clear dish visibility.
Show delivery timing and rating consistently.
dont: Do not use generic atmospheric images.
Do not crop the dish so tightly that the cuisine is unclear.

examples.title: Browse card
examples.code: <StackRestaurantCard restaurant={{ name: 'Sweetgreen', cuisine: 'Salads · Bowls', rating: 4.8, eta: '20-30 min', fee: '$2.49', imageUrl: '/sweetgreen.jpg', tag: 'Fast' }} />
